    *   As of December 31, 2017 (FY2017): $34,616
    *   **Average Accounts Payable:** $(\$25,309 + \$34,616) / 2 = \$29,962.50$

    *   As of December 31, 2017 (FY2017): $16,047
    *   **Change in Inventory (FY2017 - FY2016):** $\$16,047 - \$11,461 = \$4,586$

**2. Apply the DPO Formula:**
$$\text{DPO} = 365 \times \frac{\text{Average Accounts Payable}}{\text{FY2017 COGS} + \text{Change in Inventory}}$$

$$\text{DPO} = 365 \times \frac{29,962.50}{111,934 + 4,586}$$

$$\text{DPO} = 365 \times \frac{29,962.50}{116,520}$$

$$\text{DPO} = 365 \times 0.25714478$$

$$\text{DPO} = 93.86$$
